baselineDisplay.title: The longest suspension bridge in the world (in 1964)
baselineDisplay.text:
Step 1: Intensive reading.
Try to answer the question below while you’re reading:
Question: How is the bridge supported?
Vocabulary:
suspension n. 悬，吊
concrete n. 混凝土
agreeable adj. 宜人的
suspend v. 悬挂
situation n. 地点，地方
length n. 根，段
locate v. 确定……的位置；设置（be located 位于）
estimate v. 估计
immortal adj. 永生的，流芳百世的
capacity n. 容量；承载能力
Brooklyn n. 布鲁克林（纽约一区名）
immensity n. 巨大
Staten Island 斯塔滕岛（纽约的一个行政区）
elegant adj. 优美别致的
span n. 跨度
faintly adv. 隐约地；淡淡地
cable n. 缆索
Passage:
编者说明：本课的“世界最长”指1964年通车时的主跨纪录，不是当前排名；现行桥名拼作 Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge。4,260英尺为主跨跨度，不是桥梁全长。原教材的平台工期与承载量估计以下明确归于教材叙述，不作为现行工程荷载指标。
Giovanni da Verrazzano, a Florentine explorer sailing for France, entered New York Harbour in 1524. His account gave the name Angoulême to the surrounding land. He described a pleasant place between two hills, with a wide river flowing into the sea. His name is remembered in the Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge, which opened on November 21st, 1964. At that time, its main span was the longest of any suspension bridge in the world.
1524年，为法国航行的佛罗伦萨探险家乔瓦尼·达·维拉扎诺进入纽约港。他的航海记述把周围陆地称为安古拉姆，并描绘了两座山丘之间的一处宜人地点，一条宽阔的河流从那里汇入大海。以他命名的维拉扎诺海峡大桥于1964年11月21日通车，使他的名字为后人所记忆。当时，它的主跨跨度为世界悬索桥之最。
Notes:
1 describe…as…作“把……描绘成……”、“认为……”讲。
2 located within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river，是原教材对航海记述的引述版本。located … 修饰 situation；which 指 two small hills。in the midst of 表示“在……之中”；其后原句用了谓语 flowed 在主语 a great river 之前的倒装。本次正文改为转述，避免把教材删改过的译句当作逐字引文。
3 by no means，无论如何不，绝不。原教材用此短语评价探险家是否伟大，属于作者判断；校订正文不把这种判断当作历史事实。
4 be named after sb., 以某人的名字命名。
The Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge, designed by Othmar Ammann, joins Brooklyn to Staten Island. Its main span is 4,260 feet. The curvature of the earth had to be taken into account in its design. Two towers, rising 693 feet above the water, support four main cables. The original textbook describes the towers as standing on immense underwater platforms made of steel and concrete. It says that these platforms extend more than 100 feet below the water and took sixteen months to build.
由奥斯马·阿曼设计的维拉扎诺海峡大桥连接布鲁克林与斯塔滕岛，主跨跨度为4,260英尺。设计时必须考虑地球表面的曲率。两座高出水面693英尺的桥塔支撑着四根主缆。原教材描述，桥塔建在巨大的水下钢与混凝土平台上，并称这些平台延伸至水面以下100多英尺，建造花了16个月。这里的工期指平台，不能误译为桥塔。
Notes:
5 be taken into account, 被考虑到。
The bridge deck is suspended from cables. Each of the four main cables contains 26,108 steel wires. The original textbook illustrates the bridge’s strength with an estimate that a deck packed with cars would use only a third of its capacity. That estimate does not specify its loading assumptions and should not be treated as an operational load limit. Size and strength are not the bridge’s only qualities: its slender lines also give it a simple, elegant appearance.
桥面由缆索悬吊，四根主缆各含26,108根钢丝。原教材用一个估计说明桥的强度：即使桥面停满汽车，也仅占承载能力的三分之一。但该估计没有说明车辆荷载等假设，不能用作实际运营的荷载上限。规模与强度并非这座桥仅有的特点：纤细的线条也赋予它简洁、优雅的外观。
Notes:
6 It has been estimated …, 据估计，……。
7 be packed with …作“挤满……”、“装满……”解。
17.2【阅读理解】A record-breaking suspension bridge in 1964
Step 2: Comprehension questions.
Comprehension:
1 When did Verrazzano sail into New York Harbour? (In 1524.)
2 What name did his account give to the surrounding land? (Angoulême.)
3 How did he describe the place? (As pleasant, between two hills, with a wide river flowing into the sea.)
4 How does the bridge preserve the explorer’s name? (It is named after him; its main span was the world’s longest for a suspension bridge when it opened in 1964.)
5 Who was the bridge designed by? (Othmar Ammann.)
6 What does the bridge join? (Brooklyn to Staten Island.)
7 How long is the main span? (4,260 feet.)
8 What did Ammann have to take account of when designing the bridge? (The curvature of the earth.)
9 What do the two great towers do? (Support four huge cables.)
10 According to the original textbook, what are the towers built on? (Immense underwater platforms of steel and concrete.)
11 How far below the water does the textbook say the platforms extend? (More than 100 feet.)
12 How high do the towers rise above the water? (693 feet.)
13 What is the bridge deck suspended from? (Cables.)
14 How many steel wires does each main cable contain? (26,108.)
15 Why should the textbook’s one-third estimate not be used as an operational load limit? (It does not specify its loading assumptions.)
17.3【拓展写作】A record-breaking suspension bridge in 1964
Step 3: Composition
Describe any bridge you know well. Expand the following into a paragraph of about 150 words.
The bridge I know best is called... It joins... to... From far away it looks... but when you get near… It is made of...and supported by... If you stand on the bridge early in the morning, you can see... At this time everything is quiet. During the day, however,... I enjoy standing on the bridge at night when...In the darkness, you can see... In the stillness... are the only sounds that can be heard.
Key to composition
The bridge I know best is the Sydney Harbour Bridge. It links the city centre with the North Shore. From a distance, its great steel arch stands out against the sky. Closer up, I can see the deck hanging beneath it. The arch rests on steel bearings and foundations on both shores; the tall granite-faced pylons do not hold it up. Early in the morning, I enjoy watching the water brighten as ferries begin their journeys. Later, the harbour becomes busy with boats and ships travelling in different directions. Cars and trains pass behind me while I walk along the pedestrian path. At night, the nearby Opera House shines beside the water, and city lights are reflected on the harbour. The view always makes me pause, even when I am in a hurry. To me, the bridge is both a useful crossing and a remarkable part of Sydney’s landscape.
课外练习：
1 Why is Verrazzano’s name remembered in New York?
(a) He built the bridge himself.
(b) He designed its four main cables.
(c) He opened the bridge in 1524.
(d) A bridge with a record main span in 1964 was named after him.
2 Which geographical explanation best fits the passage? The Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge has a wide span because ________.
(a) it had to cover a wide stretch of water
(b) of the unusual shape of the earth around Brooklyn and Staten Island
(c) the water that lies between Brooklyn and Staten Island is very deep
(d) the number of wires in each cable is so great
3 Which feature of the earth does the passage explicitly say was considered in the design?
(a) The curvature of its surface.
(b) The age of the surrounding rocks.
(c) The strength of its magnetic field.
(d) The depth of its molten core.
4. Choose the phrase that describes the location as pleasant: He described the place ________ situated.
(a) as being very agreeably
(b) was very agreeable to be
(c) very agreeably having been
(d) very agreeably as being
5. Choose the simple present form: The bridge ________ the work of Othmar Ammann.
(a) is
(b) was
(c) were
(d) has been
6 The length of the main span is ________ the earth’s curvature must be taken into account.
(a) so that
(b) such that
(c) that which
(d) thus
7. Choose the usual adjective order: The textbook describes ________ beneath the towers.
(a) concrete immense platforms
(b) immense made of concrete platforms
(c) platforms immense concrete
(d) immense concrete platforms
8. Grammar practice with an imaginary model bridge: It could ________ three times the present load.
(a) carrying
(b) to carry
(c) carried
(d) carry
9. Complete this paraphrase of between two hills: There were hills ________ of the river.
(a) on either side
(b) on every side
(c) besides
(d) side by side
10 The Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge ________ Brooklyn with Staten Island.
(a) attaches
(b) unifies
(c) links
(d) relates
11 A bridge whose deck is hung from main cables carried by towers is called a ________ bridge.
(a) suspending
(b) suspense
(c) suspension
(d) suspender
12. Choose the verb meaning have enough room for: The garage can ________ twenty cars.
(a) sustain
(b) endure
(c) look after
(d) take
答案：1 d 2 a 3 a 4 a 5 a 6 b 7 d 8 d 9 a 10 c 11 c 12 d

display.text:
Step 1: Intensive reading.
Try to answer the question below while you’re reading:
Question: How is the bridge supported?
Vocabulary:
suspension n. 悬，吊
concrete n. 混凝土
agreeable adj. 宜人的
suspend v. 悬挂
situation n. 地点，地方
length n. 根，段
locate v. 位于
estimate v. 估计
immortal adj. 永生的，流芳百世的
capacity n. 承受量
Brooklyn n. 布鲁克林（纽约一区名）
immensity n. 巨大
Staten n.斯塔顿（岛）
elegant adj. 优美别致的
span n. 跨度
faintly adv. 微细地
cable n. 缆索
Passage:
Verrazano, an Italian about whom little is known, sailed into New York Harbour in
1524 and named it Angoulême. He described it as ‘a very agreeable situation located
within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river’. Though Verrazano
is by no means considered to be a great explorer, his name will probably remain
immortal, for on November 21st, 1964, the longest suspension bridge in the world
was named after him.
1524 年，一位鲜为人知的意大利人维拉萨诺驾船驶进纽约港，并将该港命名为
安古拉姆。他对该港作了这样的描述：“地理位置十分适宜，位于两座小山的中
间，一条大河从中间流过” 。虽然维拉萨诺绝对算不上一个伟大的探险家，但他
的名字将流芳百世，因为 1964 年 11 月 21 日建成的一座世界上最长的吊桥是以
他的名字命名的。
Notes:
1 describe…as…作“把……描绘成……”、“认为……”讲。
2 located within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river, 位于两座
小山之间，一条大河滔滔流过。
located…是过去分词短语作定语，修饰 situation; in the midst of which 引导一个定
语从句，which 指 two small hills。in the midst of, 在……之中。
3 by no means, 无论如何，决不。
4 be named after sb., 以某人的名字命名。
The Verrazano Bridge, which was designed by Othmar Ammann, joins Brooklyn to
Staten Island. It has a span of 4, 260 feet. The bridge is so long that the shape of the
earth had to be taken into account by its designer. Two great towers support four huge
cables. The towers are built on immense underwater platforms made of steel and
concrete. The platforms extend to a depth of over 100 feet under the sea. These alone
took sixteen months to build. Above the surface of the water, the towers rise to a
height of nearly 700 feet.
维拉萨诺大桥由奥斯马·阿曼设计，连结着布鲁克林与斯塔顿岛，桥长 4，260 英
尺。由于桥身太长，设计者不得不考虑了地表的形状。两座巨塔支撑着 4 根粗大
的钢缆。塔身建在巨大的水下钢筋混凝土平台上。平台深入海底 100 英尺。仅这
两座塔就花了 16 个月才建成。塔身高出水面将近 700 英尺。
Notes:
5 be taken into account, 被考虑到。
They support the cables from which the bridge has been suspended. Each of the four
cables contains 26, 108 lengths of wire. It has been estimated that if the bridge were
packed with cars, it would still only be carrying a third of its total capacity. However,
size and strength are not the only important things about this bridge. Despite its
immensity, it is both simple and elegant, fulfilling its designer's dream to create ‘an
enormous object drawn as faintly as possible’.
高塔支撑着钢缆，而钢缆又悬吊着大桥。4 根钢缆中的每根由 26，108 股钢绳组
成。据估计，若桥上摆满了汽车，也只不过是桥的总承载力的 1／3 。然而，这
座桥的重要特点不仅是它的规模与强度。尽管此桥很大，但它的结构简单，造型
优美，实现了设计者企图创造一个“尽量用细线条勾画出一个庞然大物”的梦想。
Notes:
6 It has been estimated …, 据估计，……。
7 be packed with …作“挤满……”、“装满……”解。

Comprehension:

2 What did he call it? (Angouleme.)

located within two mall hills in the midst of which flowed a great river’.)
4 Why will Verrazano's name be remembered? (Because the longest suspension bridge
in the world was named after him.)

12 How tall are the two towers? (Nearly seven hundred feet.)

Verrazano, an Italian about whom little is known, sailed into New York Harbour in
1524 and named it Angoulême. He described it as ‘a very agreeable situation located
within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river’. Though Verrazano
is by no means considered to be a great explorer, his name will probably remain
immortal, for on November 21st, 1964, the longest suspension bridge in the world
was named after him.
1524 年，一位鲜为人知的意大利人维拉萨诺驾船驶进纽约港，并将该港命名为
安古拉姆。他对该港作了这样的描述：“地理位置十分适宜，位于两座小山的中
间，一条大河从中间流过” 。虽然维拉萨诺绝对算不上一个伟大的探险家，但他
的名字将流芳百世，因为 1964 年 11 月 21 日建成的一座世界上最长的吊桥是以
他的名字命名的。

小山之间，一条大河滔滔流过。
located…是过去分词短语作定语，修饰 situation; in the midst of which 引导一个定
语从句，which 指 two small hills。in the midst of, 在……之中。
3 by no means, 无论如何，决不。
4 be named after sb., 以某人的名字命名。
The Verrazano Bridge, which was designed by Othmar Ammann, joins Brooklyn to
Staten Island. It has a span of 4, 260 feet. The bridge is so long that the shape of the
earth had to be taken into account by its designer. Two great towers support four huge
cables. The towers are built on immense underwater platforms made of steel and
concrete. The platforms extend to a depth of over 100 feet under the sea. These alone
took sixteen months to build. Above the surface of the water, the towers rise to a
height of nearly 700 feet.
维拉萨诺大桥由奥斯马·阿曼设计，连结着布鲁克林与斯塔顿岛，桥长 4，260 英

size and strength are not the only important things about this bridge. Despite its
immensity, it is both simple and elegant, fulfilling its designer's dream to create ‘an
enormous object drawn as faintly as possible’.

Passage:
编者说明：本课的“世界最长”指1964年通车时的主跨纪录，不是当前排名；现行桥名拼作 Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge。4,260英尺为主跨跨度，不是桥梁全长。原教材的平台工期与承载量估计以下明确归于教材叙述，不作为现行工程荷载指标。
Giovanni da Verrazzano, a Florentine explorer sailing for France, entered New York Harbour in 1524. His account gave the name Angoulême to the surrounding land. He described a pleasant place between two hills, with a wide river flowing into the sea. His name is remembered in the Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge, which opened on November 21st, 1964. At that time, its main span was the longest of any suspension bridge in the world.
1524年，为法国航行的佛罗伦萨探险家乔瓦尼·达·维拉扎诺进入纽约港。他的航海记述把周围陆地称为安古拉姆，并描绘了两座山丘之间的一处宜人地点，一条宽阔的河流从那里汇入大海。以他命名的维拉扎诺海峡大桥于1964年11月21日通车，使他的名字为后人所记忆。当时，它的主跨跨度为世界悬索桥之最。
Notes:
1 describe…as…作“把……描绘成……”、“认为……”讲。
2 located within two small hills in the midst of which flowed a great river，是原教材对航海记述的引述版本。located … 修饰 situation；which 指 two small hills。in the midst of 表示“在……之中”；其后原句用了谓语 flowed 在主语 a great river 之前的倒装。本次正文改为转述，避免把教材删改过的译句当作逐字引文。
3 by no means，无论如何不，绝不。原教材用此短语评价探险家是否伟大，属于作者判断；校订正文不把这种判断当作历史事实。
4 be named after sb., 以某人的名字命名。
The Verrazzano-Narrows Bridge, designed by Othmar Ammann, joins Brooklyn to Staten Island. Its main span is 4,260 feet. The curvature of the earth had to be taken into account in its design. Two towers, rising 693 feet above the water, support four main cables. The original textbook describes the towers as standing on immense underwater platforms made of steel and concrete. It says that these platforms extend more than 100 feet below the water and took sixteen months to build.
由奥斯马·阿曼设计的维拉扎诺海峡大桥连接布鲁克林与斯塔滕岛，主跨跨度为4,260英尺。设计时必须考虑地球表面的曲率。两座高出水面693英尺的桥塔支撑着四根主缆。原教材描述，桥塔建在巨大的水下钢与混凝土平台上，并称这些平台延伸至水面以下100多英尺，建造花了16个月。这里的工期指平台，不能误译为桥塔。
Notes:
5 be taken into account, 被考虑到。
The bridge deck is suspended from cables. Each of the four main cables contains 26,108 steel wires. The original textbook illustrates the bridge’s strength with an estimate that a deck packed with cars would use only a third of its capacity. That estimate does not specify its loading assumptions and should not be treated as an operational load limit. Size and strength are not the bridge’s only qualities: its slender lines also give it a simple, elegant appearance.
桥面由缆索悬吊，四根主缆各含26,108根钢丝。原教材用一个估计说明桥的强度：即使桥面停满汽车，也仅占承载能力的三分之一。但该估计没有说明车辆荷载等假设，不能用作实际运营的荷载上限。规模与强度并非这座桥仅有的特点：纤细的线条也赋予它简洁、优雅的外观。
Notes:
6 It has been estimated …, 据估计，……。
7 be packed with …作“挤满……”、“装满……”解。

Step 3: Composition
Describe any bridge you know well. Expand the following into a paragraph of about 150 words.
The bridge I know best is called... It joins... to... From far away it looks... but when you get near… It is made of...and supported by... If you stand on the bridge early in the morning, you can see... At this time everything is quiet. During the day, however,... I enjoy standing on the bridge at night when...In the darkness, you can see... In the stillness... are the only sounds that can be heard.
Key to composition
The bridge I know best is the Sydney Harbour Bridge. It links the city centre with the North Shore. From a distance, its great steel arch stands out against the sky. Closer up, I can see the deck hanging beneath it. The arch rests on steel bearings and foundations on both shores; the tall granite-faced pylons do not hold it up. Early in the morning, I enjoy watching the water brighten as ferries begin their journeys. Later, the harbour becomes busy with boats and ships travelling in different directions. Cars and trains pass behind me while I walk along the pedestrian path. At night, the nearby Opera House shines beside the water, and city lights are reflected on the harbour. The view always makes me pause, even when I am in a hurry. To me, the bridge is both a useful crossing and a remarkable part of Sydney’s landscape.

Key to composition
The bridge I know best is called the Sydney Harbour Bridge. It joins either side
of Sydney Harbour. From far away it looks like a great arch, but when you get near,
you can see a great deck under the arch. It is made of steel and supported by two
towers. If you stand on the bridge early in the morning, you can see the Parramatta
River to the west and the open sea to the east. At this time everything is quiet. During
the day, however, the harbour becomes busy with small boats and large ships moving
in all directions. I enjoy standing on the bridge at night when you see the magnificent
Opera House looking like a great sailing ship. In the darkness you can see the city
lights. In the stillness the traffic and the movement of the sea are the only sounds that
can be heard.
